why: Several major reviewers answer this exact question from their own testing: Wired, Engadget, Yahoo Tech (same tester), 9to5Mac hands-on and Macworld. Each names a laptop-capable bank with a retractable USB-C cable, mostly the Anker 25K 165W. A new page would not push them out.
